data_fields.name: gain_rate
data_fields.donor_constant: world rate RATE_REPUTATION_GAIN, rounded half up

best_idea: A faction standing row whose tiers come from a sorted threshold list, whose gains spill to related factions by a fraction carried between changes, and whose top tier keeps paying out in steps past the cap.
decision_why: The ladder, spill-with-carry and paragon overflow fit Frankendom's pantheon standing and realm pride; the donor's WoW factions, database spill override and integer spill are replaced by catalogue rows and a server-side carry, with D1 fixed in the sketch.
acceptance: A server test applies four one-point gains with a 0.5 sister spill and the sister gains exactly one point after the second change (carry), never a double count; a paragon cap follows the donor formula; a kill's standing change and its sister spill land in one ledger transaction.
